license_required.quote: A person may not practice optometry in this state unless the person first obtains a license and complies with the requirements of this chapter.

name.quote: "Board" means the North Dakota state board of optometry.

type.quote: The North Dakota state board of optometry consists of seven members appointed by the governor

age_minimum.quote: Is at least eighteen years of age;

moral_character_required.quote: Is a person of good moral character;

degree_required.value: Graduate of an accredited optometry school or college
degree_required.quote: Is a graduate of an optometry school or college accredited by the council on optometric education.

exams.name: Board-required examination
exams.notes: Examination required by the board by rule before license is granted
exams.quote: Before any person is granted a license to practice optometry in this state, the person must pass an examination required by the board by rule.

exams.name: North Dakota State Optometry Law Examination
exams.notes: Required for licensure by endorsement unless waived by the board
exams.quote: Pass a North Dakota state optometry law examination as required by the board to be given at such times and places as are prescribed by the board.

interval_years.quote: A license to practice optometry in the state may be issued for one year only.

required.quote: satisfactory proof the licensee has met all continuing education conditions set by the board

available.quote: An applicant may secure a license to practice optometry in this state without taking all required examinations

requirements.value: Presentation of a certified copy or original certificate of registration or license in good standing from another state with equivalent requirements; payment of fee; apply for highest level of therapeutic licensure; be current in CE; pass ND law exam; have minimum 4 years experience; no disciplinary history; submit to oral interview.
requirements.quote: Presentation of a certified copy or an original certificate of registration or license in good standing issued to the applicant by another state where the requirements for license are equivalent to those of this state

is_mandatory.quote: A person may not practice optometry in this state unless the person first obtains a license and complies with the requirements of this chapter.

title_protection.quote: Displaying a sign or in any way advertising as an optometrist.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated any provisions of this chapter or the rules and regulations of the board, or committed an offense with a direct bearing on ability to serve the public as an optometrist
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated any provisions of this chapter, the rules and regulations of the board, or committed an offense determined by the board to have a direct bearing upon a holder's ability to serve the public as an optometrist

disciplinary_grounds.description: Sold or distributed any drug legally classified as a controlled substance or as an addictive or dangerous drug
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has sold or distributed any drug legally classified as a controlled substance or as an addictive or dangerous drug;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Addicted to the excessive use of intoxicating liquor or a controlled substance for at least six months prior to filing of charges
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been addicted to the excessive use of intoxicating liquor or a controlled substance for at least six months immediately prior to the filing of the charges;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Afflicted with any contagious or infectious disease
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is afflicted with any contagious or infectious disease;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Grossly incompetent to discharge duties in connection with the practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is grossly incompetent to discharge the holder's duties in connection with the practice of optometry;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employed fraud, deceit, misrepresentation, or fraudulent advertising in the practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has employed fraud, deceit, misrepresentation, or fraudulent advertising in the practice of optometry;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in the practice of optometry by being employed by any person other than a licensed optometrist, physician, hospital, or clinic operated by licensed optometrists or physicians
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is engaged in the practice of optometry by being directly or indirectly employed by any person other than a licensed optometrist, a physician licensed under chapter 43-17, a hospital, or a clinic operated by licensed optometrists or by licensed physicians.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Mental or physical ability to practice optometry with reasonable skill and safety is impaired
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the board may restrict, suspend, or revoke the license of any licensed optometrist whose mental or physical ability to practice optometry with reasonable skill and safety is impaired.

definition_quote.value: The determination, interpretation, and treatment of any visual, muscular, neurological, interpretative, or anatomical anomaly of the eye which may be aided, relieved, or corrected through visual training procedures or through the use of lenses, prisms, filters, ophthalmic instruments, pharmaceutical agents, or combinations thereof, held either in contact with the eye, or in frames or mountings, as further authorized by this chapter. Laser therapy and the use of invasive surgery are not permitted under this chapter, except superficial foreign bodies may be removed and primary care procedures may be performed.
definition_quote.quote: "Diagnosis and treatment" means the determination, interpretation, and treatment of any visual, muscular, neurological, interpretative, or anatomical anomaly of the eye which may be aided, relieved, or corrected through visual training procedures or through the use of lenses, prisms, filters, ophthalmic instruments, pharmaceutical agents, or combinations thereof

methods_authorized.quote: aided, relieved, or corrected through visual training procedures or through the use of lenses, prisms, filters, ophthalmic instruments, pharmaceutical agents, or combinations thereof

drug_authority.value: Optometrists certified by the board may prescribe and administer diagnostic and therapeutic pharmaceutical agents including topical agents, locally administered agents, oral anti-infectives, oral antihistaminics, and oral analgesics for ocular-related disorders; nonscheduled pharmaceutical agents with documented ocular use (except acetaminophen with 30mg codeine)
drug_authority.quote: "Therapeutic pharmaceutical agents" includes topically administered and prescribed pharmaceutical agents for treatment of ocular-related disorders or disease, locally administered pharmaceutical agents for primary eye care procedures, oral anti-infective agents, oral antihistaminic agents, and oral analgesics for the treatment of ocular-related disorders or diseases.

surgery_prohibited.quote: Laser therapy and the use of invasive surgery are not permitted under this chapter, except superficial foreign bodies may be removed and primary care procedures may be performed.

surgery_definition.quote: Laser therapy and the use of invasive surgery are not permitted under this chapter

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: except superficial foreign bodies may be removed and primary care procedures may be performed.

minor_surgical_procedures_authorized.quote: except superficial foreign bodies may be removed and primary care procedures may be performed.

vision_therapy_authorized.quote: aided, relieved, or corrected through visual training procedures

value: acetaminophen with thirty milligrams of codeine excluded from pharmaceutical agent definition
controlled_substance_schedule_restrictio.quote: The term includes nonscheduled pharmaceutical agents, except for acetaminophen with thirty milligrams of codeine, that have documented use in the treatment of ocular-related disorders or diseases.

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: oral anti-infective agents, oral antihistaminic agents, and oral analgesics for the treatment of ocular-related disorders or diseases.

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: Before any optometrist may prescribe and administer pharmaceutical agents in the treatment and management of ocular diseases, the optometrist must first be certified or qualify for certification in the use of diagnostic pharmaceutical agents.

tiered_license_types.quote: Apply for the highest level of therapeutic licensure in this state.

specialty_certification_types.quote: the optometrist must first be certified or qualify for certification in the use of diagnostic pharmaceutical agents. For additional certification to prescribe and administer pharmaceutical agents in the treatment and management of ocular disease

pharmacology_training_hours_required.quote: the board shall require at least seventy-six hours of didactic instruction and twenty-four hours of clinical application of pharmaceutical agents for the treatment and management of ocular diseases.

supervised_clinical_internship_required.quote: twenty-four hours of clinical application of pharmaceutical agents for the treatment and management of ocular diseases.

referral_to_physician_required.quote: Any optometrist authorized by the board to use pharmaceutical agents shall consult with a physician duly licensed to practice medicine when any diseased or pathological conditions of the eye do not respond to treatment.

telemedicine_authorized.quote: A licensed optometrist may act as a distant site provider and use telemedicine to provide care in accordance with standards of practice established by the board by rule.

impaired_practitioner_program_establishe.quote: the board may restrict, suspend, or revoke the license of any licensed optometrist whose mental or physical ability to practice optometry with reasonable skill and safety is impaired.

jurisprudence_exam_required.quote: Pass a North Dakota state optometry law examination as required by the board to be given at such times and places as are prescribed by the board.
